name: com.responsly.sdk
description: Show Responsly surveys inside your iOS and Android game: as a bottom sheet, a dialog or full screen, triggered by events, screens and user traits. Targeting runs on the device. The package wraps the native Responsly iOS and Android SDKs, which are included.

samples.description: A test panel drawn with IMGUI: initialize, identify, track, screen, show a survey, pause, close and reset, with a log of every SDK event. Add the ResponslyDemo component to an empty GameObject and build to a device.
